edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Not an accepted settlement (exception X2)
    Given treatment "T-0001" is not an accepted settlement, or its state is not the one R-SET-10 allows
    When the booking step is triggered by TreatmentApproved for "T-0001"
    Then nothing is written, no outbound request leaves and no event is published

  Scenario: AC4 Stale ACE data (exception X3)
    Given the ACE data product for business date 2027-02-26 is stale after a late or failed batch
    When the read-back runs
    Then the read-back holds, nothing is written, the data date is shown and MSG-P1-001 is raised

  Scenario: AC5 Contract does not answer (exception X4)
    Given the rwb-treatment contract does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the activity is called
    Then the activity retries on the workflow's own backoff, nothing is written and no event is published

  Scenario: AC6 Outbound item in exception (exception X5)
    Given the outbound item reaches EXCEPTION or the interface row is not in force
    When the read-back is due
    Then there is no read-back and no TreatmentBooked, and the case stays with operations

  Scenario: AC7 Booked position does not match (exception X6)
    Given the booked position or the settlement payment does not match the accepted terms of "T-0001"
    When the read-back runs
    Then no TreatmentBooked is published, one task for the case owner is raised and the difference is recorded

  Scenario: AC8 Repeated treatment or key (exception X7)
    Given the same TreatmentApproved or the same Idempotency-Key arrives twice
    When the second arrival is processed
    Then the stored answer is returned, no second item and no second event are created, and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC9 Forbidden read or write (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reads a v_ace_* view, another rwb_* schema or a recovery_* table
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
